newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TENNIS-HINGIS LEADS SWITZERLAND INTO WORLD GROUP.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HINGIS LEADS SWITZERLAND INTO WORLD GROUP.

text.p: Wimbledon champion and world number one Maritina Hingis led Switzerland to 5-0 Fed Cup win over Argentina on Sunday and promotion to the World Group for next season.
Hingis, playing at home for the first time in almost a year, clinched the World Group two tie with an emphatic 6-2 6-1 victory over top-ranked Argentinian Florencia Labat.
She beat the world number 37 in the first match of the reverse singles to give Switzerland an unbeatable 3-0 lead.
"I consider this as a big victory," said Hingis. "It's important that we get to play in the World Group next year.".

Patty Schnyder continued the rout with 6-1 6-0 dismantling of Marie Jose Gaidano in a dead rubber singles, played out before another disappointingly small crowd at the half-filled 2,000 seat Saalsporthalle.
Hingis teamed up with Emmanuelle Gagliardi to complete the sweep with a 6-3 6-4 doubles win over Mercedes Paz and Laura Montalvo.
